lines.tts: This is Oath-roll. I built it for the M L H Solana Hackathon.
I just talked the AI game master into lowering my difficulty. He sent the change... The program refused it.
You can type any action. The Keeper is Claude Haiku. It writes a D C and four outcomes,
and seals all of it on Solana before any dice roll.
First I just demand D C one. No luck, nothing sent.
Second try: flattery, dated today so you know it's live. He bites, and offers fourteen. Fourteen is a legal D C, so that's not the problem.
Here's the transaction he sent. My words are in the log, right above Table Sealed.
With preflight skipped, a failed transaction still lands on chain, so the plea is kept. The D C is still sixteen.
Now the roll. The program asks Magic Block's V R F for randomness. About seven seconds, real time... A two. Setback, and the seal cracks.
The proof page reads this ruling straight from Solana, in your browser. It can't prove the Keeper was fair, only that nobody changed the ruling after the seal.
That's the callback: the V R F program calling mine.
Next game I rolled a twenty and a fifteen, and stole the clapper in three turns.
Every refused plea lands on this wall. Those are mine, from tonight.
The code, and every transaction here, is in the read me.
